lessons.trigger: the PR checkout has an unrelated active exclusive task and uncommitted work
lessons.requiredBehavior: Work from an isolated branch at the fetched PR head, keep one task-local lock and ledger, and serialize later integration.
lessons.failureCondition: The active private-case task, its files, or its working copy are overwritten or staged.
lessons.repairAction: Stop, preserve both trees, and restore isolation before continuing.

lessons.trigger: a first-class threat taxonomy and policy controller overlap established behavior-based threat assessment
lessons.requiredBehavior: Preserve the independent conception, scan official and primary sources, then compose established pathway concepts with existing runtime mechanisms and invent only the local adapter.
lessons.failureCondition: The runtime encodes a homegrown threat label system without mapping or limits, or literature silently replaces the owner lesson.
lessons.repairAction: Reconcile the design against the strongest primary source and narrow the bespoke remainder.

lessons.trigger: violent or threat-adjacent content can produce both safety overreach and dangerous underreaction
lessons.requiredBehavior: Keep ideation distinct from mobilization and imminence; preserve engagement at low risk, assess proportionately during escalation, and prioritize external safety action only when evidence supports it.
lessons.failureCondition: Violent words alone trigger generic emergency prose, or concrete operational progression remains an abstract discussion.
lessons.repairAction: Correct the state, route, prompt, and regression so both inverse failures are mechanically represented.

lessons.trigger: risk evidence must survive compaction but later evidence may lower concern
lessons.requiredBehavior: Persist current evidence and level as a structured revisable value with provenance; keep historical evidence without freezing the present level.
lessons.failureCondition: Compaction drops an unresolved risk or a past high-risk state permanently controls later routing after current evidence changes.
lessons.repairAction: Restore evidence-bound state projection and explicit supersession/reassessment tests.

lessons.source: project audit architecture protocol + universal independent evaluation separation
lessons.trigger: the audit harness can itself overcorrect a well-calibrated response
lessons.requiredBehavior: Add inverse error classes and good controls; semantic harness edits invalidate prior calibration and require a new freeze before live calls.
lessons.failureCondition: A good engagement can be rewritten into generic emergency prose without penalty, or stale calibration is reused.
lessons.repairAction: Block live evaluation, repair the instrument, and require complete recalibration.

lessons.trigger: critical safety logic with a large repository suite and an owner-required PR verification boundary
lessons.requiredBehavior: Use focused/affected tests in the inner loop, one full package checkpoint after the final changed state, and the required privacy/hosted checks at closeout.
lessons.failureCondition: Repeated unchanged full suites waste time or focused safety evidence is skipped.
lessons.repairAction: Return to focused tests; run the complete gate only at a meaningful changed-state checkpoint.
